asr.full_text: Hi guys, what's up? So today's video is going to be a little bit of a different one. Today, two years ago, I decided you could call it on YouTube, which is so exciting. My friend Taylor actually gave me this idea. I went to Gigi's Cupcakes today and I got a little cupcake to celebrate my two year anniversary on YouTube. If this falls over, I'm going to cry. Here's the little cupcake I got. It is the birthday surprise. I don't know. It looks cute. So I wanted to get it. This is the only lighter I had at home. So don't do had at home oh don't do this at home kids I'm gonna blow out the candle the smell of like blown up birthday candles is so disgusting to me hmm it's just an average really sweet cupcake but it's good we're gonna take literally like almost all this frosting off that was so sweet oh my god so really quickly I wanted to go over the roles and everything of this giveaway to be 18 or older or have a parents permission this giveaway is also for the United States only sorry but there will be giveaways in the future that will be international but this one is not international it also for the United States only sorry, but there will be giveaways in the future that will be international But this one is not international It is for the United States only and the giveaway will close on August 27 So you have a month from today to enter and the rules on how to enter you just have to click the link in the Description box and then it will take you to a site called gleam You'll follow the directions on there, and then that's it. It's super simple and easy easy. There also are bonus entries so if you want to follow me on Twitter and Instagram that gives you two extra bonus entries. So there's going to be two winners for this giveaway. The first one is going to be a $50 gift card to Sephora which I'm gonna send you through like an email link. And then the second prize is going to be this little goodie bag of makeup that I got from beautycon. I'm gonna get into the makeup that I'm giving away. So I have everything in this bag that I got at Beautycon. Just a preface, none of these products have been opened or used. They're all brand new. So the first thing that you're going to get is these Young Nails caption art screens by iitt girl I think? So they have 12 nail stamping patterns. Next is the voluminous feline noir mascara. You're going to get a ton of Face masks 7 of these face masks Also, you're going to get the so fresh so clean young cool now groovy green tea wash off mask Joanne be my everything blush and bronze palette Inspired by K Beauty this Palmer's cocoa butter formula with vitamin E this Charlotte by Charlotte Roos eyeshadow palette So this one is the flour galaxy glaze holographic lip gloss which is like a cool like bronzy color this one is the Revlon super lustrous lipstick in 720 which is fire and ice the next one is another Revlon product which is the super lustrous fatal apple I think it's a lipgloss and then the other one is the covergirl cream lipstick in 305 hot you'll also be getting this luscious lip stain by duchey i don't know how you pronounce that but it's in the color 618 dark lust and then this is a little like essence eyeshadow palette so you can like put whatever ones you want in it and the eyeshadows that came with that is this brown eye shadow in the color miss foxy roxy this is a fixing powder in fix-it baby this is a blush in strawberry smoothie and another eyeshadow which is like a shimmery white color in the color snowflake you'll also get two little silicone sponge like makeup applicators you'll also get this um Crayola Sally Hansen instant dry color in the color wild watermelon. You will also get a NYX lingerie liquid lipstick in the color embellishment. You'll get this really cool one this is the J Cat Beauty flash metal metallic lip. It's like this super cool color. You'll also get this Kajole pen by pop beauty in the color inky purple and this the main choice green tea and carrot deep strengthening and restorative mask treatment so good luck to all of you guys that enter and i will be contacting you through twitter instagram or your email that you provided so be sure to check those on the week of august 27th because i will be contacting the two winners so i just wanted to say thank you guys so much for All of the love and support that you have given me over the last two years I have grown so many amazing friends and subscribers And I'm so thankful that you guys are willing to watch my videos and support me You meet people from so many different places and that's what I love about YouTube so much I have so many good memories from starting a YouTube channel And I have them all documented on camera and some people may think that having a YouTube channel is really weird and that's your own opinion but I think it brings me happiness and I love doing it we're also really close to 2,000 subscribers so if you want to hit subscribe and stick around and enter the giveaway and everything definitely do so that is going to be everything for this video I can't believe it's been two years it's insane time flies w hen you're having fun I hope you guys enjoyed Thank you guys so much for always supporting me I love you guys so much and i will see you soon bye guys SMACK
